item.title: 'Bit of pain' worth long-term security from Iran, Bessent tells BBC
item.summary: US Treasury Secretary said a "small bit of economic pain" was worth it to eliminate the threat of Iranian strikes on Western capitals.

item.title: Hamas rejects Gaza disarmament plan, Palestinian official says
item.summary: The official tells the BBC that the armed group will not move forward with talks until Israel fully complies with its commitments.

item.title: 'They are striking everywhere' - Paramedics in Lebanon speak to BBC after Israeli strikes
item.summary: BBC Middle East correspondent Hugo Bachega joins paramedics on duty in Nabatieh - a city that was once vibrant, but is now abandoned.

item.title: Israel and Lebanon hold first direct talks since 1993
item.summary: A US statement said the two sides had agreed to launch direct negotiations, at a time and place to be determined.

item.title: US blockade of Iran ports irresponsible and dangerous, China says
item.summary: China, the biggest buyer of Iranian oil, says the US naval blockade undermines an "already fragile ceasefire".

item.title: Hungary's next PM would pick up if Putin calls and tell him to stop Ukraine war
item.summary: Russia has offered "pragmatic" relations, but Péter Magyar says he will not call Vladimir Putin himself.

item.title: Three years of messages at once - a chronicle of Sudan's war pours in as trapped reporter's phone turns on
item.summary: As the conflict enters its fourth year, journalist Mohamed Suleiman shudders at what has been lost.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] South Korea jails American YouTuber for public nuisance
item.summary: Johnny Somali sparked outrage after kissing a statue representing World War Two sex slaves.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] Magyar to meet Hungarian president as Trump says next PM 'a good man'
item.summary: The man who ended Viktor Orbán's 16 years of continuous rule, Péter Magyar, is calling for a speedy transfer of power.

item.title: 250 missing after migrant boat sinks in Indian Ocean
item.summary: The trawler "reportedly sank due to heavy winds, rough seas and overcrowding", the United Nations said.
